no-restricted-syntax.message: CSS owns visibility — never set `.hidden` on shadow internals. Toggle a data-* attribute on the host and select it in CSS (`:host([data-*]) .el { display: … }`).
CSS owns visibility — never set `.style.display`/`.style.visibility` in JS. Toggle a data-* attribute on the host and select it in CSS.
